name: stamp_progressive_tranches
rule: docs/features.md, fiscal rules, Droit de timbre: cash only (card and credit pay nothing); nothing at 300,00 DA or less; tranches = ceil(amount / 100,00 DA); 1,00 DA per tranche when the whole amount is at or under 30 000,00 DA, 1,50 DA up to 100 000,00 DA, 2,00 DA above, the whole amount at its band's rate; minimum 5,00 DA; no cap. The base is total_ttc (assumption, see the doc row). Amounts and expectations are integer centimes written by hand.
note: The half-dinar on an odd tranche count at 1,50 DA is exact in centimes (301 × 150 = 45 150). The open question in the doc row only exists if the tax must be paid in whole dinars; nothing here rounds.

cases.name: 300,00 DA cash is at the floor, nothing due
0,01 DA cash is under the floor, nothing due
a zero basket in cash owes nothing
300,01 DA: ceil(30 001 / 10 000) = 4 tranches x 1,00 DA = 4,00 DA, raised to the 5,00 DA minimum
450,00 DA: ceil(45 000 / 10 000) = 5 tranches x 1,00 DA = 5,00 DA, exactly the minimum
500,00 DA: 5 tranches x 1,00 DA = 5,00 DA, a whole number of tranches
600,00 DA: 6 tranches x 1,00 DA = 6,00 DA, the first amount above the minimum
1 000,00 DA: 10 tranches x 1,00 DA = 10,00 DA
30 000,00 DA: 300 tranches x 1,00 DA = 300,00 DA, the last amount in the 1,00 DA band
30 000,01 DA: 301 tranches x 1,50 DA = 451,50 DA, the whole amount at the new band's rate
30 100,00 DA: 301 tranches x 1,50 DA = 451,50 DA, an odd tranche count, exact in centimes
100 000,00 DA: 1 000 tranches x 1,50 DA = 1 500,00 DA, the last amount in the 1,50 DA band
1 000 000,00 DA: 10 000 tranches x 2,00 DA = 20 000,00 DA, no cap
